name: Buon Giardino Produce
description: Buon Giardino Produce grows Cherries, Squash, Corn, Tomatoes, and Green beans in Lockeford, CA. The farm is small, and its seasons run through spring and summer. The harvest is typically at its peak in spring. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from May – Jun in this growing zone.
